run_visualize_segmentation: run the hydra-configured main function to visualize segmentation boxes and masks from instance files onto RGB images
run_load_rgb: run load_rgb to open an RGB image file by name from a directory, trying .png and .jpg extensions
run_load_instance: run load_instance to load a torch checkpoint file and return predicted boxes and masks as numpy arrays
review_VisualizeSegmentationConfig: review the VisualizeSegmentationConfig dataclass that defines instances, output, rgb, draw_masks, and draw_mask_indices fields for Hydra
refactor_main: refactor the main function to customize box drawing, mask blending weights, or output directory structure for segmentation visualization
